title: P ZERO Race TLR RS
notes: Official tech specs read 2026-11-01: 26-622 270 g, 28-622 290 g, 30-622 310 g, 32-622 340 g, 35-622 370 g; 120 TPI SpeedCORE. Page: latest addition to the P ZERO Race range, made in Italy, developed with World Tour teams; SmartEVO2 compound for further improvement in grip and handling on dry and wet surfaces, with improved overall grip especially on wet surfaces and record-low rolling resistance for its category. No hookless statement or maximum pressure.
